J1.evidence: Verse «الظّاعنين ولمّا يظعنوا أحدا»: ظعن is intransitive ('to depart'), so الظاعنين = 'those who move off/depart (before having made anyone depart)'. TR 'göç ettirenler' (those who cause to depart) gives the wrong meaning, and adds unmarked '[olarak]'. EN 'those who move off' is correct.

J2.evidence: «الظّاعنين» is the participle of intransitive ظَعَنَ = 'those who depart/move off'; «ولمّا يظعنوا أحدا» = 'though they have not yet made anyone depart'. TR 'Henüz kimseyi göç ettirmemişken göç ettirenler' renders الظاعنين as causative ('those who make others depart'), a wrong meaning; it should be 'göç edenler'. In addition the TR carries several unmarked bracket insertions that resolve the text on the translator's authority: '«[الراسخون] zamir ile merfûdur»' for the ambiguous «رفع بالضمير» (the Kufan claim may concern يؤمنون/the subject), '[المقيمين] medih üzere nasb edilemez', '[helâk olmasın]', '[iffetliler]'; these belong in a [Mütercim notu: …].

tr.fixed_note: الظاعنين now 'göç edenler' (not causative), unmarked [olarak] removed; [الراسخون], [المقيمين], [helâk olmasın], [iffetliler], [Taberî], [منهم] moved into Mütercim notları
tr.verify_note: الظاعنين now 'göç edenler' (correct, intransitive); former unmarked brackets ([الراسخون], [المقيمين], helâk olmasın, iffetliler, Taberî, منهم) are all inside Mütercim notu; rest complete and faithful.
